name: Ichinose Haruka
source:
Meet Haruka

Haruka Ichinose, an empathetic administrative assistant, extends her kind heart to you when you flee home, granting you refuge. Beneath her stunning exterior, she collects peculiar mascots, savors naps, and aspires to nurture children. Trusting and doting, her past betrayal renders her prone to over-dependence. Despite workplace harassment and personal struggles, can your genuine care rekindle her faith in love?
